title: Executive Chef
description:
What you'll do...

  • Reporting to our Director of Food & Beverage, you'll lead the culinary vision and overall kitchen operation across The Hoxton Southwark, overseeing Albie, Seabird and our Meetings & Events operation.
  • Provide strategic leadership across all kitchen operations, ensuring consistency of quality, execution and standards whilst allowing each venue to retain its own identity.
  • Lead, inspire and develop the kitchen teams, creating a high-performance culture built around coaching, accountability and continuous development.
  • Be responsible for menu development across all outlets, creating commercially successful, seasonally driven concepts that reflect each brand while continually evolving the offer.
  • Work closely with the Director of Food & Beverage and operational leaders to develop revenue-driving initiatives, activations and guest experiences that strengthen the commercial performance of each venue.
  • Take ownership of food cost, labour, payroll, purchasing and kitchen productivity, ensuring budgets are achieved whilst maintaining exceptional quality and consistency.
  • Build strong supplier relationships, sourcing the highest quality ingredients and continually reviewing purchasing opportunities to maximise value.
  • Ensure the highest standards of food safety, health & safety, cleanliness and legislative compliance across every kitchen operation.
  • Support the planning and delivery of Meetings & Events, exclusive hires and bespoke dining experiences, ensuring flawless execution regardless of scale.
  • Develop talent across the kitchen teams, identifying high performers and creating clear development opportunities that build capability across the business.
  • Work collaboratively with Restaurant General Managers, front of house teams, bars, sales, events and hotel departments to deliver one seamless guest experience.
  • Be visible across the operation, supporting services where required, mentoring the team and maintaining consistently high culinary standards.
  • Continuously challenge the status quo, identifying smarter ways of working that improve quality, efficiency and profitability without compromising creativity or guest experience.

What we're looking for...

  • Previous experience as an Executive Chef, Executive Sous Chef or in a similar senior culinary leadership role within a premium, high-volume hospitality environment.
  • Experience overseeing multiple food concepts simultaneously, balancing operational excellence with creative menu development.
  • A proven leader with the ability to inspire, coach and develop large kitchen teams whilst building a positive, accountable and high-performing culture.
  • An exceptional understanding of food cost management, labour planning, payroll, purchasing and kitchen financial performance.
  • Commercially astute with a strong understanding of menu engineering, gross profit, labour productivity and operational performance. You know how to balance exceptional food with delivering strong business results.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise multiple outlets, competing demands and high-profile events without compromising standards.
  • A genuine passion for menu innovation, seasonality and creating memorable dining experiences that reflect the individuality of each concept.
  • Excellent knowledge of food safety legislation, allergen management and kitchen compliance.
  • A collaborative leader who builds strong relationships across departments and enjoys working closely with operational teams to deliver shared success.
  • Calm under pressure with the ability to make confident decisions, solve problems quickly and support your teams during busy service periods.
  • Passionate about developing people and creating opportunities for others to grow their careers.
  • A true passion for hospitality and delivering experiences that reflect the integrity of our brands.
  • Individuals. You're looking for a place where you can be yourself; no clones in suits here.
  • You're all about having a positive impact on the people you interact with, leaving both guests and your team with memorable experiences.
  • You're not precious. We leave our egos at the door and help get shit done.
  • You're up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once.
  • If we got stuck in a lift together, we'd have a good time and share a few laughs.
  • You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other and has fun along the way.

What's in it for you...

  • Competitive salary + discretionary bonus dependant on company KPI's.
  • 28 days holiday (inclusive of bank holidays), pension and life insurance.
  • A health cash plan to claim money back and get access to lots of ways to support your physical & mental wellbeing.
  • It's ok not to be Ok, we have a confidential hotline for any support you require about anything and a network of Mental Health First Aiders.
  • Treat yourself once in a while with lots of retail & hospitality perks through our partners.
  • Enjoy a free night at The Hoxton and a meal for two when you first start with us.
  • Goes without saying, but we'll feed you during your shift.
  • Excellent discounts across the Ennismore family for you and your nearest and dearest (even if you decide to leave us!).
  • Free night at The Hoxton every year and something a little extra £££ when you hit the big milestones!
  • Lots of opportunity to progress and switch it up as part of a global family of brands.

title: Aquatics Supervisor
description:
Ready to join a dynamic company in the hospitality and service industry where people help drive the success of the business? Since its inception in 1957, Invited has operated with the central purpose of building relationships and enriching the lives of our members, guests and more than 17,000 employees. We are the largest owner and operator of private clubs nationwide, with 130+ country clubs, city clubs, and athletic clubs. Our Clubs offer first-class amenities, including championship golf courses, modern workspaces, handcrafted cuisine, resort-style pools, state-of-the-art racquet facilities, fitness centers, and much more. Come be a part of this incredible and inclusive team at Invited!

Job Summary

The Aquatics Supervisor is responsible for supporting the daily operations of the aquatic facility, ensuring a safe and well-maintained environment for all users. This role helps in overseeing lifeguards, monitoring safety protocols, and assisting with the coordination of day-to-day aquatic activities. The Supervisor also works closely with management to ensure smooth facility operations and assists in providing excellent service to members and guests.

Reporting Structure

  • Reports to the Aquatics Director
  • May report to the Fitness Director in the absence of a Aquatics Director

Day to Day

  • Communicate with members regularly and promote aquatic club activities.
  • Assist in hiring, supervising, and developing aquatic personnel to ensure staff are welltrained thereby creating a safe environment for those who use the facility.
  • Help verify the accuracy of time reporting in Kronos.
  • Participate in bi-monthly in-service training drills to maintain safety standards.
  • Assist in staff training, ensuring all employees are up to date on certifications, including CPR, first aid, and lifeguarding.
  • Support the implementation of aquatic programs, such as swim lessons, fitness classes, or special events.
  • Assist with coordinating the logistics for swim meets or other aquatic related activities.
  • Assist with the timely setup and breakdown of aquatics programs.
  • Ensure the pool facility is always in a safe environment.
  • Clean and sanitize swimming pool including cleaning the pool and backwash filters, skimming pool surfaces, and checking that chemicals in the pool are at ideal levels.
  • Help ensure areas around the pool are clean and clear of equipment and debris.
  • Ensure equipment (i.e. railings, ropes, pumps, etc.) is in good working order and report repair/replacement as needed.
  • Oversee the daily operations of the pool, ensuring proper water quality, cleanliness, and overall safety of the pool area.
  • Assist with opening and closing procedures, including securing the pool area and conducting inspections of equipment and facilities.
  • Monitor pool chemical levels, equipment functionality, and general facility maintenance, reporting any issues to the Director and/or Manager Aquatics.

Additional Duties

  • Due to the dynamic nature of the club, employees are expected to assist others as needed and take on additional tasks as assigned by management.
  • Follow all company, club, and department policies, procedures, and instructions.
  • Represent the company's management team by supporting and enforcing policies while maintaining the highest standards of ethics and integrity.
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism and a commitment to excellence in interactions with members, colleagues, and staff.
  • Promote and follow safe working practices, ensuring compliance with safety guidelines and encouraging others to do the same.
  • Take the initiative in personal and professional growth and maintain any required certifications relevant to your role.
  • Address and resolve challenges using available resources, working with regional and corporate teams to support club operations.
  • Support the overall efficiency of the team by collaborating and contributing to the club’s goals.

About You

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience in an aquatic facility or similar role.
  • A minimum of 3 years of competitive swimming or be a certified swim coach.
  • Current certification in CPR, first aid, and AED.
  • Lifeguard certified.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Recreation, Sports Management, or related field.
  • Previous supervision experience.

Physical Requirements

  • Frequent swimming, sitting, standing, walking, and driving.
  • Occasional exposure to temperature changes, dust, fumes, or gases.
  • Squatting, kneeling, reaching, grasping, twisting, and bending.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 100 lbs. on occasion.
  • Talking, hearing, and seeing.

Primary Tools/Equipment

  • Tubes, life vests, and AEDs.
  • First aid kits and safety signage.
  • Pool skimmers, nets, and vacuum systems for cleaning.
  • Water testing kits.
  • Chemical dispensing systems.
  • Smartphones or tablets.
  • Office supplies.

Work Schedule

  • Adherence to attendance requirements as outlined in the weekly schedule.
  • Flexibility to work additional hours as needed to meet position deadlines.
  • Availability to work on weekends and/or holidays as required.

What We Offer

We believe in taking care of our team, and our Total Rewards package reflects that commitment. Your actual base pay will be determined by your skills, experience, education, location, and—if you're in a non-exempt role—hours worked. While not all roles at Invited are full-time, those full-time team members have access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Generous paid time off and leave programs (time off as required by applicable law is also provided for part time team members)

Want to learn more? Visit for full details.

Have more questions? Check out our Invited Jobs website for more details about ClubLife, the Employee Experience, Company Benefits, and Our Culture. Be a part of our Social Networks: LinkedIn Instagram Twitter Facebook

Invited is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

The job posting outlines the general requirements for this position and is not a comprehensive list of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Additional duties not mentioned here may be assigned as needed to ensure the smooth operation of the Club.

title: Oracle Developer
description:
Senior level Oracle Forms, Reports, BI Publisher Developer (5+ years) with relevant experience in production support and development . Should have advanced development experience with Oracle E-Business suite (EBS) and Oracle Tech stack. Position will require strong knowledge of Oracle Forms, Reports, PL/SQL, BI Publisher, Oracle Application Framework (OAF). Candidate must have strong Technical experience with Oracle Financials suites GL, AR, AP, Projects and Grants.

Skills Required:

• Oracle Forms
• Oracle Reports
• BI Publisher
• PL/SQL, Packages, Procedures etc.
• Oracle Financials suite


Optional Skills:
• Oracle Applications Framework (OAF) development and customization.
• Experience with R12.2 version of Oracle EBS.
• Oracle Workflow Development experience.
• Experience with large ERP migration/conversion projects.
• Experience with SQL performance tuning and optimization.
• Oracle Fusion Middle Ware (FMW) integration.


Job Responsibilities:
The candidate should have hands on knowledge of Oracle E-Business suite. Advanced level Oracle Forms and Reports development experience is required. Candidate should have experience working and deploying large scale enterprise level Oracle Forms/Reports based applications.
Day to day tasks will require PL/SQL, Oracle Forms & Reports Development, BI Publisher reports, Develop and Debug code modules within the EBS framework. Troubleshooting, performance tuning and maintenance of existing Oracle codebase. Job functions will also require the candidate to work on some weekends and evenings to support EBS maintenance activities. Oracle OAF forms development, customization, Workflow Builder experience is desired. Candidate will need to be a self-starter, flexible, good communication skills and be able to work well in a team.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.

We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

description:

title: Commercial Counsel
description:
About CoreView

CoreView is the global leader in Microsoft 365 (M365) tenant resilience, serving over 23 million users worldwide. We empower the world’s leading organizations to master the complexity of Microsoft M365. Through robust security and precise governance, we help ensure that our client’s environments stay cyber-resilient and productive, no matter how complex they are.

Our unified, cloud-native platform delivers powerful automation, rapid value, and end-to-end visibility across the entire M365 ecosystem. Backed by world-class support and a collaborative, innovative culture, CoreView is a place where your ideas matter, and your work truly impacts global enterprises.

The Role

We are looking for a Commercial Counsel to own the full lifecycle of our customer and vendor agreements. This role requires a high degree of independence and the ability to operate across multiple time zones, partnering closely with stakeholders to enable deals while managing risk. This is a high-volume, high-trust role where speed and judgment matter equally. You will report to the Chief Financial Officer.

What You'll Do

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a high volume of SaaS agreements including MSAs, Order Forms, DPAs, NDAs, and partner/reseller agreements
  • Manage the full contract lifecycle — from initial redlining and negotiation through execution — with a high level of ownership and urgency
  • Partner closely with teams across legal, sales, finance, and operations to resolve contract issues and align risk with business objectives
  • Identify legal and commercial concerns in proposed terms and develop practical solutions that balance protection with deal progression
  • Advise on ARR-related contract terms including multi-year commitments, auto-renewal clauses, true-ups, and uplift provisions
  • Ensure contractual alignment with revenue recognition requirements (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) in collaboration with Finance
  • Support high-volume agreement handling while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and compliance with company standards
  • Maintain and improve standard contract templates, playbooks, and fallback positions
  • Contribute to process improvements related to contracting workflows and documentation management
  • Support international deal structuring across multiple jurisdictions, with a US-primary focus and exposure to EU, UK, and APAC
  • Manage GDPR, UK GDPR, SCCs, CCPA, and cross-border data transfer obligations within customer agreements
  • Advise internal stakeholders on contractual risk, escalating material issues appropriately
  • Track and manage contract obligations, renewal dates, and compliance requirements in the CLM system
  • Develop and maintain commercial templates, playbooks, and guidelines to standardise negotiations and improve deal velocity.

Required

  • Active license to practice law in at least one US jurisdiction
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience; 6-10 years strongly preferred in commercial contracting roles
  • Deep working knowledge of SaaS contract structures — subscription models, SLAs, usage-based pricing, and ARR mechanics
  • Strong experience drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and redlining a broad range of commercial agreements
  • Strong commercial instincts — you protect the business without killing deals
  • Proven ability to negotiate directly with enterprise procurement and legal counterparties
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and manage competing priorities effectively
  • Strong legal judgment and confidence in making decisions independently.
  • Experience in handling corporate matters and drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements.
  • Experience with data privacy matters, IT security and/or corporate law is meritorious.
  • Your focus is on achieving meaningful business outcomes, translating into actionable advice delivered clearly and comprehensively.
  • Experience with international contracting across multiple jurisdictions, with working knowledge of EU, UK, and APAC legal frameworks
  • Solid understanding of data privacy frameworks (GDPR, UK GDPR, SCCs, CCPA, and APAC equivalents such as PDPA/PIPL)
  • Strong legal judgment and confidence in making decisions independently.
  • Experience in handling corporate matters and drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements.
  • Experience with data privacy matters, IT security and/or corporate law is meritorious.
  • Your focus is on achieving meaningful business outcomes, translating into actionable advice delivered clearly and comprehensively.

Nice to Have

  • In-house experience at a SaaS or technology company
  • Familiarity with CLM tools (e.g., Ironclad, Icertis, DocuSign CLM)
  • Experience supporting a sales organization through quarter-end crunch
  • Exposure to revenue recognition principles and their interaction with contract terms
  • Knowledge of U.S., EU, UK, and APAC procurement or public sector contracting

Key Competencies

  • Commercial judgment — translates legal risk into business terms
  • Speed and pragmatism — finds workable solutions without over-lawyering
  • Communication — explains complex positions clearly to non-lawyers
  • Collaboration — trusted partner to Sales, Finance, and Product
  • Attention to detail — catches what matters without slowing things down

Coreview Values

Ownership Mindset: Take ownership. Drive outcomes.

One Team: One team, one goal, embracing diversity - to achieve more together.

Velocity: Decide fast. Deliver fast. Repeat.

Continuous Improvement: Curiosity drives us. We challenge the status quo.

Customer First: Listen deeply. Solve boldly.

Resilience: Steady under pressure.

CoreView is an organisation which values the strength that diversity brings to the workplace. As an employer, we seek to promote equal opportunity through affirmative action. All qualified applicants will therefore receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on gender/sex, race/ethnicity, disability, age or any other protected group status (such as protected veteran status) or characteristic that is protected by local legislation.

Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that CoreView will process your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with our Privacy Policy

title: Director of Delaware Trust
description:
Mechanics Bank is currently searching for a Director of Delaware Trust to join our team. Here at Mechanics Bank, we value connection, partnership, long term relationships and working together in person. This role will be working on-site.

The Director of Delaware Trust is responsible for the overseeing and management of sales activities and the cultivation of trust business. Must maintain a thorough knowledge of the various trust and tax laws and governing regulations in conjunction with Bank and Government/Agency policies. Responsible for staying abreast of all federal and state regulatory policy changes within the industry, make policy recommendations and manage the process for compliance with existing requirements/guidelines. Is responsible for quality control of business accepted as well as cultivating new business opportunities to sustain and increase profitability of the Bank's Trust and Investment portfolio.

What you will be doing:

  • Proactively administers and manages activities for assigned trust, adhering to the terms of the governing documents. Accurately interpret and apply provisions of governing documents consistent with applicable statutes and regulations. Manages all tax and legal activities related to assigned accounts.

  • Communicates with clients, beneficiaries, care managers, attorneys, CPAs, portfolio managers and other professionals to resolve problems and concerns with accounts. Authorizes discretionary and non-discretionary payments and gathers appropriate backup documentation, as needed.

  • Lead and participate in sales activities and help control quality of business accepted. Work closely with trust officers, private bank relationship managers, portfolio managers and other wealth management professionals in the cultivation of trust business opportunities (i.e. trust, custody, and escrow).

  • Works with both internal and external clients;

    • Build and deepen relationships with centers of influence (i.e. accounting firms and law firms) in an effort to solidify referral sources.

    • Develop and maintain effective links with all units of Bank and affiliated companies to ensure meaningful cross-selling and/or support of trust activities.

    • Serves as the liaison between trust compliance and trust staff.

  • Mentor junior trust officers and associates on significant account administrative matters and business development activities. Lead by example to ensure the quality of:

    • Delivery of products and services.

    • Marketing and sales activities.

    • Demeanor and deportment of trust employees.

  • Participates and contributes to departmental activities designed to improve the account management process, such as TAC, NAAC and the training conducted by Trust managers. The Director of Delaware Trust will be a member of the Trust Administrative Committee of Mechanics Bank Wealth Management, and certain sub-committees as needed.

  • Participate as a member of the Senior Management Team of Mechanics Bank Wealth Management.

  • Serve as a member of its Board of Directors. Serve on Board, Level 1 and Level 2 committees for the Mechanics Bank Trust Company of Delaware.

  • Prepare and present training materials educating internal partners on the benefits of Delaware trust, as well as how to identify and refer opportunities. Conduct training via video conference and periodically in person. Serve as a subject matter expert on Delaware trusts and related fiduciary topics.

  • Continually enhances knowledge of trust, tax and related areas by participating in ongoing educational functions, including those offered by the trust team and those available from third parties. Participates in creating and developing fiduciary services.

  • In collaboration with Director of Wealth Management, accountable for financial performance, profitability, and resource management, including capital and expense budgeting, staffing, and cross-functional coordination to improve efficiency and effectiveness of the Mechanics Bank Trust Company of Delaware.

  • Interaction with regulators in coordination with the Regulatory Compliance team of Mechanics Bank Wealth Management. Primary contact for the Delaware OSBC and interaction on regulator matters.

  • Travel 20 - 30%.

​Who you are:

  • 10 years of trust administrative experiences are required.

  • 4 year college degree with preference of a JD degree.

  • CTFA-Certified Trust and Fiduciary Advisor is preferred.

  • Through knowledge of Trust requirements including account transfer policies, practices, and procedures.

  • Thorough knowledge of the features and benefits of special situs trusts, the differences between Delaware and other special situs, as well as the requirements and process for decanting trusts to Delaware.

  • Strong knowledge of estate and tax planning techniques and their appropriate application.

  • Extensive understanding of trust accounting systems.

  • Knowledge of securities, real estate, LLCs, limited partnerships and other entities.

  • Must be thoroughly familiar with and adhere to all applicable, federal and state laws, regulations and guidance, including those related to Anti-money laundering (i.e. Bank Secrecy Act, US PATRIOT Act, etc.)

  • Must have experience supervising trust personnel, including coaching development, counselling, team building and motivational/inspirational leadership experience.

  • Proven track record of business development success.

  • Exceptional communication skills.

  • Must be knowledgeable of all Bank policies and procedures; completing required training.

  • Excellent analytical skills; reviewing various data sources including reports and manuals.

  • Must be able to communicate effectively via telephone and in person.

  • Excellent organizational ability.

  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

​ADA Requirements:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear, and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls.

  • The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.

  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

#LI-HJ1

Pay: $ 200,000 - $300,000 annually

AIP Bonus up to 30%

Our comprehensive employee benefits program is designed for you to live your best life at work, home, and everywhere in between. Employees working 25 hours or more per week are eligible for health benefits effective the first day of the month following or coinciding with their date of hire.
Benefits package includes[1]:

  • Medical, prescription, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members

  • Employer paid Employee Assistance Program, Life Insurance, AD&D, and Disability benefits

  • Health Savings Account with employer contribution

  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts and Commuter/Parking Benefit

  • 401(k) and Roth 401(k) with company contribution

  • 529 Education Savings plan, Tuition Reimbursement Program and Student Loan Assistance Program

  • Supplemental Health plans, Voluntary Legal and Identity Theft Services

  • 11 paid holidays, paid Sick days (accrual of one hour for every 30 hours worked), up to 25 paid vacation days, and 16 hours of paid volunteer time throughout the calendar year

  • Free personal checking and savings account; Discounted rates on primary residence loan with $0 origination fees (restrictions apply)

Final compensation package will be determined by the work experience, education, and/or skill level of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with geographic market data.

title: Client Executive
description:
Client Executive

Role Overview

Client Executives at Cabin Consulting play a pivotal role in the development and nurture of long-term, sustainable client relationships. Leaders in this role are accountable for top-line revenue and profitability of specified accounts - attained through driving a tailored account strategy, fostering strong client relationships, and identifying new business opportunities within the realms of digital innovation, product development, and digital adoption.

Through creation of high-performing teams, this role is also responsible for developing and commercializing opportunities, which includes crafting compelling points of view and driving the proposal and Statement of Work (SOW) creation process. Additionally, the Client Executive takes ownership of delivery management, ensuring successful project setup, staffing, quality oversight, and seamless project closeout. They also contribute to the growth of the team by supporting the professional development of individuals assigned to their accounts, ensuring the alignment of resources and fostering an environment of continuous learning and improvement.

This multifaceted leadership position requires a balance of strategic thinking, relationship acumen, complex problem-solving, and strong operational execution.

Why Cabin?

At Cabin, we are more than just a digital innovation firm—we are a dynamic, boutique consultancy where creativity and collaboration thrive. Specializing in digital product discovery, design, and delivery, we work with clients across industries to bring groundbreaking ideas to life. As a company, we embrace a culture of deep focus, high-impact problem solving, and long-term partnerships, fostering an environment where innovation and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do.

The name "Cabin" reflects the essence of our work philosophy. Like a cabin in the woods, our space is a sanctuary for thoughtful reflection, creativity, and growth. Here, we remove the distractions of the outside world to focus on what truly matters—creating exceptional products that drive business success. Just as a cabin brings people together in a quiet, welcoming environment, we bring together talented professionals to collaborate, innovate, and achieve extraordinary results. At Cabin, you’re not just part of a team; you’re part of a community where your ideas are valued, your expertise is elevated, and your career can flourish.

Joining Cabin means taking on high-impact, high-visibility digital initiatives while working alongside a diverse, talented team of strategists, designers, and developers. You'll have the opportunity to shape the future of digital products, drive transformative change for our clients, and influence the product lifecycle from strategy through execution.

If you’re ready to contribute to meaningful work, drive digital transformation, and bring strategic vision to life, Cabin is the place for you.

Responsibilities

  • Account Strategy
    • Lead the strategic planning process for assigned accounts, ensuring alignment with client goals and business objectives and driving future business growth between Cabin and Client.
    • Develop and manage commercial agreements to drive mutually beneficial partnerships.
    • Position Cabin’s value proposition effectively, ensuring the delivery of tailored solutions that exceed expectations.
    • Monitor client satisfaction and take proactive steps to maintain and improve relationships.
  • Relationship Development
    • Own and nurture relationships with key executives, buyers, and stakeholders within client organizations, becoming a trusted advisor.
    • Expand existing relationships by identifying new buyers and fostering cross-functional connections.
    • Map organizational structures and develop relationship maps to understand key decision-makers and influencers within the client organization.
  • Opportunity Development
    • Partner with Capability Leadership to socialize offerings and create client proposals
    • Own the full opportunity lifecycle from identification to proposal creation, pricing and profitability, and Statement of Work (SOW) execution.
    • Manage opportunities within the sales pipeline, ensuring timely progression and addressing any obstacles.
    • Regularly report on the status of opportunities to leadership, providing clear updates on pipeline health and next steps.
  • Delivery Management
    • Oversee project work at a macro level, ensuring overall quality, alignment with client expectations, and smooth execution.
    • Proactively identify and remove blockers, collaborating with the team to keep projects on track.
    • Assist with staffing decisions and project setup to ensure that the right resources are in place for successful delivery.
    • Ensure delivery quality throughout the project lifecycle and manage project closeout to ensure all goals are met.
  • People Development
    • Serve as a strategic mentor for individuals assigned to accounts, providing guidance on both industry-specific knowledge and consulting skills.
    • Foster an environment of continuous learning, helping team members grow professionally and develop their expertise.
    • Support the career progression of team members, providing feedback and advice on skill development and opportunities for growth.

Qualifications

  • Consulting Experience: 5-10 years of experience in consulting or adjacent professional services industries, with a proven track record of leading successful client engagements in the areas of digital innovation, product development, and digital adoption.
  • Sales & Account Management: Strong background in sales, account development, and client relationship development or related experience. Demonstrated ability to identify and drive new business opportunities while managing ongoing client relationships to ensure satisfaction and growth. Trusted network of relevant relationships that can support the evolution of Cabin.
  • Relevant Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of digital transformation, digital strategy, and emerging technologies. Experience working with clients in industries undergoing significant digital change, with the ability to apply that knowledge to drive impactful solutions.
  • Leadership & Influence: Proven ability to provide leadership and influence to both internal teams and clients, driving account growth and delivering high-quality results. Ability to mentor, guide, and motivate team members to excel in their roles while achieving account objectives.
  • Strategic Mindset: Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to align client needs with consulting solutions that deliver measurable value. Comfortable navigating complex accounts, identifying and mitigating risks, and making decisions that influence the overall direction of the business.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to build relationships at all levels of the client organization. Collaborative approach to working with internal teams to ensure seamless delivery and client satisfaction. Demonstrated ability to communicate verbally, in writing, and in presentation form.
  • Growth Mindset: Strong desire and hustle to scale a quickly-growing business by leveraging the talents of a high-performing team. Ability to effectively work within startup environment.
  • Financial and Operational Acumen: Experience planning for and managing financial and operational targets and objectives.
  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of how to support and build professional services business.

title: Senior Manager - Hospitality Design Management
description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Senior Manager - Hospitality Design Management to join our team! In this role you will manage and coordinate the design development of hospitality assets from initial briefing through to delivery. You will support the translation of vision into distinctive and buildable design outcomes, driving quality, guiding key decisions and ensuring alignment with guest experience, positioning and Operator requirements. Working across consultants, Operators and internal stakeholders, you will coordinate design interfaces, decision-making processes and help ensure designs are integrated, compliant and delivered in line with programme and quality objectives.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Manage and coordinate the design development of hospitality assets from early-stage briefs through to delivery, ensuring alignment with guest experience, asset positioning and the client's vision and objectives
  • Lead, manage and coordinate consultant teams, Operator interfaces and stakeholder inputs to support the delivery of integrated, buildable design solutions
  • Manage and monitor design progress across all project stages, ensuring deliverables, reviews, approvals and timelines are met
  • Drive design quality and integrity across architecture, interiors, landscape, including mock-up rooms, materials, FF&E and OS&E

title: Patient Monitoring/Telemetry/Diagnostic Cardiology Field Engineer 1 - Central & Eastern Washington
description:
Job Description Summary

The Field Engineer I performs on time and accurate Preventative Maintenance in one or more modalities of equipment. The Field engineer 1 is aware of and follows all Field Modification Instructions and/or Instrument Service Information bulletins. Works with experienced Field Engineers, both onsite and remotely, to learn troubleshooting, repair and equipment installation techniques. Responsible for driving customer satisfaction through Service Excellence.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Learn to complete on-time and accurate Preventative Maintenance, FMIs and/or ISIs.

  • Assist more experienced field engineers with equipment installation.

  • Work with experienced field engineers on basic troubleshooting and service repair needs on designated equipment.

  • Effectively communicate and partner with teammates and colleagues.

  • Learn to effectively communicate with customers to ensure resolution and proper follow-up, leading to customer satisfaction.

  • Partner with the customer and recommend value-added services that will help the customer run their business more efficiently.

  • Keep up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining customer service logs and internal service records in a timely manner, ordering repair parts, and managing cycle times.

  • Utilize the GEHC escalation process, as needed, and work closely with region and national support to define and implement corrective action plans to resolve customer issues in a timely manner.

  • Serve as a member of the account community for key accounts.

  • Effectively engage commercial counterparts, identify potential sales leads, participate in sales opportunities such as contract renewals, and assist with promoting and implementing revenue programs.

  • Focus on customer needs and satisfaction, while building on and enhancing the relationship with the customer to ultimately become a perceived partner in their business.

  • Keep up to date with competitor information and market trends.

  • Answer service calls independently without assistance within one year of employment.


Required Qualifications:

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field; OR equivalent military education; OR participant in the formal GEHC Biomed/FE Services Internship or Military Externship program; OR High School Diploma/GED and 4 or more years of experience servicing electronic equipment.

  • Experience with Web applications as well as Microsoft suite of products.

  • Must have and maintain a valid Driver's License.

  • Willingness to be available ""after hours"", or work a rotating On-Call schedule, including weekends, for critical issues and coverage, as necessary.

  • Candidate must be able to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 35 lbs. unassisted and frequently bend, stoop, twist, climb, crouch/squat, kneel/crawl, sit and stand for long periods of time.

title: Teachers at Beck Road KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.

We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

You will read every GC subcontract that comes through our door, find the clauses that put us at unacceptable risk as a subcontractor, and negotiate them out before signature.

About Cosmo Cabinets
We manufacture kitchen and bath cabinets in Eatonton, Georgia. 350,000 square feet under roof. 1,500 cabinets a day. KCMA, NGBS, and BABA certified. Family-owned, American-made.

We sell, supply, and install cabinets and countertops in multi-family apartment projects across the Southeast. Every project starts with a subcontract written by a general contractor, for the general contractor. The terms in those construction contracts decide whether a good project stays profitable or turns into eighteen months of back-charges and delay claims. We are hiring one person to own that.

What You Will Do
  • Review GC subcontracts, master subcontract agreements, purchase orders, and change orders for terms that unfairly shift risk onto us as a subcontractor
  • Redline contracts, issue exception letters, and negotiate directly with general contractors' contract administrators and project executives until we reach terms we can sign
  • Flag deal-breakers to leadership early with a clear recommendation: sign, negotiate, or walk away
  • Build and maintain our subcontract clause playbook — standard positions, fallback positions, and hard limits — so the same negotiations don't repeat on every project
  • Track insurance requirements, additional insured endorsements, bonds, and certificate compliance against what each construction contract actually demands
  • Manage lien waivers, preliminary notices, and notice deadlines across active multi-family projects
  • Pull the governing contract language when a dispute, back-charge, or delay claim surfaces mid-job, and support the project team through it
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on the contracts that genuinely require a lawyer, and handle the rest without one
Subcontract Clauses You Will Live In
Pay-if-paid and pay-when-paid. Broad-form and intermediate-form indemnity. No-damages-for-delay. Liquidated damages. Consequential damages waivers. Retainage and release conditions. Flow-down and incorporation-by-reference. Termination for convenience. Acceleration and schedule compression. Back-charge and set-off rights. Warranty scope and duration. Change order procedure and notice requirements. Dispute resolution, venue, and choice of law. Insurance and additional insured requirements.

If those terms are familiar, this job will make sense to you immediately.

What You Need
  • 5+ years reviewing and negotiating construction contracts, on the subcontractor side or the general contractor side
  • A legal background: JD, paralegal certificate, or equivalent hands-on construction contract experience with real depth
  • Direct experience with AIA contract documents, ConsensusDocs, and GC-drafted custom subcontracts
  • Working knowledge of Georgia lien law and payment bond law; multi-state exposure is a plus
  • Judgment to tell the difference between a clause that is uncomfortable and a clause that is dangerous
  • The spine to hold a position with a general contractor's contract department, and the sense to know when to trade
  • Clear, precise writing — your redlines and exception letters go out under our name
Preferred
  • Multi-family or residential construction experience
  • Familiarity with cabinet, millwork, casework, or finishes trades
  • Contract lifecycle management software experience
  • Georgia bar admission (not required)
Compensation and Benefits
  • $75,000 – $90,000 per year, depending on experience
  • Health, dental, and vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Offered
  • PTO - 3 Weeks
  • On-site in our Sandy Springs office

title: Graphic Design Intern (Fall 2026)
description:
Graphic Design Intern - Austin, Fall 2026 (Remote possible)

At GigFinesse, we’re not just changing the game, we’re redefining how live entertainment is booked across the U.S. In just a few years, our platform has powered more than 50,000 shows in 70+ cities, transforming everything from intimate rooftop sessions to marquee venue performances. Our innovative approach has earned recognition from Forbes 30 Under 30, Crain’s Business, and leaders across the hospitality ecosystem.

As we continue to scale, we’re looking for passionate, creative individuals to join our team. If you’re excited about building a more accessible, equitable, and reliable platform for artists and venues to connect, create, and thrive, we’d love to meet you.

Position Overview

GigFinesse is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Design Intern to support our marketing team. In this role, you will help shape the visual identity of our brand, working on everything from social media assets and platform infographics to internal sales decks. This role offers the opportunity to build a robust portfolio with real-world work while gaining exposure to the fast-paced music-tech industry.

Responsibilities:

  • Design engaging visual content for social media platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Create digital and print assets for venue partners
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure brand consistency across all touch points
  • Edit and retouch photos from live events for promotional use
  • Translate complex data or concepts into clear, visually appealing infographics

Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communications, or related fields
  • Proficiency in graphic design tools is required
  • Strong typography, layout, and branding skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage deadlines
  • Passion for live music and an eye for current design trends
  • Interest in the entertainment industry

Additional Information:

  • This is an unpaid internship for credit only
  • Either in-person in Austin, Texas or remote
  • Internship period: Fall 2026

title: Commercial HVACR Service Technician
description:
Commercial HVACR Service Technician - Tired of the same old routine? At Helios, we’re changing the game in commercial mechanical service and we want you to be part of it. We’re the fastest-growing and most trusted HVAC/R partner in the country, and our superhero technicians are at the heart of it all.

Many of our top leaders started right where you are turning wrenches and solving problems. If you’re a high-energy, skilled technician who’s passionate about HVAC/R and ready to be recognized for your work, this is your moment, and Helios is your home.

We’re not just looking for a technician. We’re looking for top technicians in the industry.

What Sets Helios Apart:

  • Top Pay — dispatched from home and paid door-to-door
  • Health benefits start DAY ONE (includes an employee-only ZERO cost option)

  • Very generous PTO policy – in addition to paid holidays
  • Tool allowances (PLUS employer-provided tools)
  • Career growth opportunities, promote from within culture
  • Incredible bonus and recognition programs
  • Company vehicle, fuel card, smart phone, and uniforms
  • Continuing education course offered on Helios University

What Helios Needs From You:

  • Ability to diagnose, repair, and calibrate commercial HVACR systems
  • Problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and/or as part of a team
  • Excellent communicator with customers and support staff
  • Keep your van stocked and your tools sharp
  • Deliver quality service and integrity every single day
  • Be a reliable resource for nights, weekends, and on-call emergencies.
  • Invest in your skills through training and certifications
  • Valid drivers license

What Sets You Apart:

  • Universal EPA certification
  • Valid driver’s license
  • 2+ years in commercial HVAC — refrigeration experience a big plus

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills
  • Basic technology skills — you can navigate mobile apps and documentation with ease

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 75 lbs and frequently move heavy objects.

title: Associate Cardiac Technician
description:
Sanford Health, the largest rural health system in the United States, is dedicated to transforming the health care experience and providing access to world-class health care in America’s heartland.





Work Shift:

Varies (United States of America)



Scheduled Weekly Hours:

0



Compensation:

Salary Range: $17.00 - $25.50





Union Position:

No



Department Details

Flexible hours, fast pace, learn a new skill

Summary

Examines heartbeat patterns on electrocardiograph (EKG) monitors to detect any abnormal heart rhythms.

Job Description

Assists physicians in emergency responses to heart irregularities. Observes an electrocardiograph (EKG) monitor and examines heartbeat patterns to identify any abnormal variations in heart rhythms. Recognizes emergency situations and informs physicians so immediate medical action can be taken. Records the heart's electrical activities using an EKG monitor and checks the quality of recorded material. Orders and stocks supplies as necessary. Prints an EKG report, detailing a patient's cardiovascular condition, for physician interpretation and diagnosis.

Qualifications

High school diploma or its equivalent is required.



Certified Cardiographic Technician (CCT) certification, Cardiac Rhythm Monitoring certification (CRAT) or National Telemetry Certification (National Telemetry Association) encouraged but not required. Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification is preferred.

Sanford is an EEO/AA Employer M/F/Disability/Vet.

description:
Yodeck is a fast growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company that is laser focused on disrupting the $23B digital signage industry. Yodeck’s affordable, easy to use, and feature rich solution has been developed to democratise digital signage and empower businesses around the world. Since its introduction in 2016, Yodeck has powered over 200.000 screens across every type of business, from restaurants and retail stores to schools, stadiums, and conference halls. As one of the top 5 digital signage SaaS platforms globally, Yodeck is looking for curious and smart people to help us drive even faster growth.

About the Role

As a Partner Success Associate, you'll support our Channel Partner team across day-to-day operations, partner communications and CRM management.

This is a 12-month contract based in Athens (hybrid). It reports to the Head of Partnerships EMEA.

Responsibilities

Partner Operations

  • Run and optimise partner onboarding
  • Handle data entry, CRM updates and pipeline hygiene
  • Assist with MBR and QBR scheduling and preparation
  • Track and flag open action items, billing follow-ups — closing loops and assisting to partner needs
  • Support with long-tail partner communications: run regular touchpoints, answer product questions, and escalate where needed
  • Keep partner records clean and up-to-date in HubSpot

Learn How the Channel Works

  • Build working knowledge of Yodeck's platform, pricing, and partner programme
  • Contribute to building the playbooks, templates, and processes we're creating as a team

Requirements

  • Recent graduate in Business, Marketing, Communications or similar (0–2 years experience — first internship welcome)
  • Fluent English, native or near-native Greek
  • Strong written communication — this role runs on email, Gdocs, and HubSpot
  • Comfortable in spreadsheets and project trackers — you don't need to be a wizard, but you can't be afraid of a formula
  • High follow-through — you close loops, you don't wait to be chased
  • Organised, direct, and open to feedback

Bonus Points For

  • Prior exposure to B2B, SaaS, Sales Ops, or Customer Success
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, Asana, or Google Workspace

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Company-wide bonus scheme and a great Stock Option plan
  • Amazing workplace, certified as Great Place to Work
  • Hybrid Work From Home policy
  • Office gym, nutritionist, and meal vouchers
  • Individual training budget for professional development
  • Private medical insurance plan
  • Fun and collaborative start-up environment (with amazing offices!)
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Commuting Expenses
  • Equal opportunity and workplace diversity

As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, Yodeck is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity. Our people are our strongest asset and we acknowledge that all we have achieved so far is the solid outcome of our people’s contributions.

title: Teachers at West Cary KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.

We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

  • Must be willing to adapt to other platforms and technologies.

title: Talent Pipeline
description:
About Cro Metrics

At Cro Metrics, we're on a mission to redefine growth for organizations and brands through unparalleled digital experiences that inspire action and deliver results. We are an experiment-led growth marketing agency that partners with mission-driven and high-growth companies to scale through data-driven experimentation. Our expertise spans A/B testing, personalization, paid media, lifecycle marketing, and full-funnel digital strategy — empowering clients to make smarter decisions that drive measurable results.

Our fully remote team of strategists, analysts, engineers, and creatives works across industries including eCommerce, fintech, nonprofit, and hospitality. We believe in autonomy, collaboration, and innovation as we help our clients grow smarter and faster.

Join Our Talent Pool

Don't see an open role that fits right now? We're always looking to connect with sharp, curious people in marketing, CRO, and analytics, even when we don't have an active opening.

We work with growth-minded brands on experimentation, conversion optimization, analytics, and lifecycle marketing, and our team grows in bursts as client work ramps up. That means the right opportunity for you might not exist today, but could next month.

We're especially interested in hearing from people with backgrounds in:

  • CRO / experimentation & testing
  • Analytics & data (GA4, Looker, SQL, etc.)
  • Paid media & digital marketing
  • Email / lifecycle marketing
  • UX/UI design
  • Front-end development
  • Project or program management

How it works:
Submit your resume and a short note about what you're great at and what kind of work excites you. We review talent pool submissions regularly, and when a role opens that matches your background, you'll be one of the first people we reach out to.

Cro Metrics is an equal opportunity employer. We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: 2027 Graduate: Engineering & Information Technology (2 year Fixed Term)
description:
Oh what a feeling!

We are so much more than just the sum of our parts. Our strength comes from working together, sharing ideas to always find new ways to progress. Together, we are Toyota.

Toyota Australia is looking for engineering graduates that want exposure to specific opportunities that our business can offer.

  • Work for a leading, innovative and well-respected global brand

  • Structured development program and involvement in cross-functional projects

  • Unparalleled company culture that encourages continuous improvement

In Australia there are two separate businesses: Toyota Motor Corporation Australia (TMCA) and Toyota Finance Australia (TFA). While we work closely together, Toyota Finance Australia’s priority is to provide finance, insurance and fleet management, while Toyota Motor Corporation Australia is continuously innovating to develop products that meet the needs of the market both now and into the future - we offer mobility solutions for people to move, and be moved.

When you join Toyota, you join a family that supports you to always do better, developing, evolving, and collaborating to make your impossible, possible.

Our Graduate Program has multiple positions available in Altona North on a 2-year contract, commencing in February 2027, for those who have studied in the Engineering discipline (Mechanical, Process, Automotive, Electrical, Mechatronics) or Information Technology discipline (Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Cyber Security).

We are looking for Graduates who are enthusiastic about becoming future Toyota leaders. With our program, no two days will be the same - you’ll experience different areas of the business and become a key player in contributing towards Toyota’s overall business strategy.

During the course of your two-year program, you’ll get a broad understanding of our organisation by undertaking multiple teams. You will have the opportunity to work across our different divisions across our Victoria locations.

Designed to accelerate your transition from studies to work life, the program provides you with options to build a strong career foundation and expand your leadership capabilities along the way.

Our Graduate Program offers tailored development activities, including several Toyota-wide experiences, projects, and mentoring opportunities. If you join you will:

  • Participate in World leading Toyota Global Content Training to mould you into a Kaizen guru by learning our methodology on systems and processes.

  • Become emersed in supply chain by experiencing our Toyota Parts Centre (TPC)

  • Learn from our customers in our Customer Experience Centre

  • Grow your project management and problem-solving skills by taking on projects individually or together with your teammates.

Come with us and help create the future.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Senior Planning Engineer to join our team! What You'll Be Doing:

  • Provides guidance, direction, and specialized assistance for the resolution of difficult project control problems.

  • Analyzes, evaluates, and forecasts current status against an established baseline schedule.

  • Assesses the impact(s) of design or construction changes and schedule slippages.

  • Reports status of schedule to appropriate project and Company management as well to the client.

  • Understands and applies engineering, procurement, and construction terminology, concepts, and relationships.

  • Develops and maintains critical path logic networks and bar charts utilizing this information.

  • Customizes project control systems to meet specific project requirements.

  • Accumulates historical data, such as performance experience, for use in maintaining a realistic basis for future planning and forecasting.

  • Supervise and provide performance reviews for one or more lower-level Project Control Engineer/Specialists and/or support personnel.

  • Provides input to Sr. Project Control Staff regarding staffing requirements.

  • Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

What Required Skills You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Construction Management or related field (or equivalent experience) and typically 10+ years of related work experience.

  • Requires basic engineering knowledge in electrical, mechanical, civil, or a related field. Proficient PC skills including proficiency in various Project Controls software and Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Supervision Received - Higher Level Project Control Staff Supervision Given - Lower-level employees on project (technical direction only)Internal Contacts - All employees on project and interface with Parsons departments External Contacts - Clients; Suppliers; Government Agencies

title: Teachers at Plantation KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.

We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.
